Interface CouchbaseRepository<T,ID>

All Superinterfaces:
CrudRepository<T,ID>, PagingAndSortingRepository<T,ID>, Repository<T,ID>
All Known Implementing Classes:
SimpleCouchbaseRepository
@NoRepositoryBean public interface CouchbaseRepository<T,ID> extends PagingAndSortingRepository<T,ID>, CrudRepository<T,ID>
Couchbase 专用的 Repository 接口。
